entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to process a return for a VeloBand GPS Tracker.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I start with your name and order number?
Sarah Jenkins, order 88-V-F-7-2-9. Just send me the return label.
Thank you, Sarah. Pulling that up now... Okay, I see the order. Just for my records, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's not broken. It's just not what I wanted. I was going to return it weeks ago, but there was a family emergency and I didn't have time.
I understand. I'm sorry to hear that. I just need to verify the return eligibility. I see it was delivered 25 days ago.

Look, my father was scheduled for a sudden deployment, but ended up in the hospital. He needed emergency surgery. I've been dealing with that for the last three weeks. I haven't had a chance to mail a package. Can you process this return or not?
Of course. My apologies, and I hope he's recovering well. Let me just double-check our official return policy here... one moment.

Okay, thanks for waiting. I've checked the knowledge base, and our policy states you have 90 days from the delivery date for a return. Since you're only on day 25, you're well within the timeframe. I'll approve this for you right now.
Great. So you're sending the label?
Yes. I've just processed the return authorization. The shipping label and instructions have been sent to the email address on your account. You'll receive a full refund once we receive the item.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope things get better for you and your family.
